decisions: Explicit owner canon and quest outcomes govern. Participant plans and claims remain attributed.
Fresh blood depicts captives being driven inward; Scribonia’s initial opposite reading is corrected in the quest.
Mya’s light frees the captives and protects against gas/contamination, not every possible harm. The executioner escapes as mist.
The seed is observed. Four seeds and one destroyed are the nomad’s account; planting is not completed here.
The divided defense’s outside diversion lacks a complete combat log in this main window. Only visible fire, return, wounds and pursuit are narrated.
Two distinct Nymera deaths: immediate explicit Revivify, then ash. The unconsumed diamond is a bounded observed exception. Sajhan is not Nymera.
The later ash handoff, Elenia’s attempt and subsequent living presence do not identify the missing second spell or completion scene.
The corrected warm/cold collision and actual less-potent storm govern the discarded description and speculative larger storm.
Eugene uses Wish while his copying is incomplete; banishing his attacker is not a recorded permanent kill. Arjahn carries him from the rising flood.
The smaller lava outflow and obscured aftermath do not establish the Knight’s death or every civilian casualty. Later Abyss activity remains a later discovery.
Protected parentage, bound-helper disclosures, private origins, exact weather recipes, raw/controller/rules/reward data and images are excluded.
calendar: Four existing milestones retain all original dates, day numbers, ranges, precision, importance and regions. Rescue preparation begins before the existing 23rd milestone; no new elapsed story day is invented.
